about_short_description.short_description: Mercura streamlines sales quotations for HVAC, electrical, and plumbing distributors, saving time and increasing revenue.

product.name: AI Quoting for wholesalers & manufacturers
product.description: Automates the generation of sales quotations by finding spec-compliant products quickly and reducing errors in response to customer requests.

product.name: Automated Bill of Quantities (BOQ) Processing
product.description: Automatically matches bill of quantities documents to the correct products in inventory, eliminating manual matching by sales teams.

product.name: Automated Bill of Materials (BOM) Processing
product.description: Imports and processes bills of materials in any format, using AI to instantly match parts to inventory products.

product.name: Sales Reporting
product.description: Provides visibility into sales activities and performance by location and employee to support business analysis and strategy development.

product.name: Product Data Enhancement
product.description: Enriches and categorizes product catalogs by integrating external data to improve product information management.
